doc.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23

title: Records with Leon Rene in Los Angeles
summary: He recorded in the early 1930s with Leon Rene's small band, naming sidemen, and says most of his work was in big bands before Liggins.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
